2653-2893-7941-8345.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Syndicate Liquidators trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Syndicate Liquidators trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

116-512-5457.easyPrerequisites: Selvala and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-5457.description:
Activate Selvala by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Selvala, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-5457.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Selvala's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

654-1315-2693-5721.easyPrerequisites: Land cards in your graveyard and under your control can tap to add at least {4}{G}{B}.
654-1315-2693-5721.description:
Activate each untapped land you control by tapping it, adding mana.
Activate Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it.
In response, activate Zuran Orb repeatedly by sacrificing each land you control, gaining life each time.
Resolve the Aftermath Analyst ability, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
For each land that enters, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping it.
Activate Phyrexian Reclamation by paying {1}{B} and 2 life, returning Aftermath Analyst from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Aftermath Analyst by paying {3}{G}.
Aftermath Analyst enters, triggering itself, causing you to mill three cards.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

676-1115-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
676-1115-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Magnus the Red, triggering Breath of Fury and Magnus the Red.
Resolve the Magnus the Red trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

101-1987-2427.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that taps to produce at least {U}
101-1987-2427.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Vampire Charmseeker.
When Vampire Charmseeker enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
101-1987-2427.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

1409-3099-6723-7730.description:
Activate Deadeye Navigator by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Deadeye Navigator by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Deadeye Navigator enters the battlefield, its soulbond ability triggers, repairing it with another creature.
Repeat.

1495-6593-7741.description:
Cast Gatta and Luzzu by paying {2}{W}.
When Gatta and Luzzu enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, targeting itself, but instead putting two +1/+1 counters on it due to Gatta and Luzzu and Shang-Chi.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 3.
1495-6593-7741.notes: You can forego step 4 to simply put infinite +1/+1 counters on Triskelion if desired.

2034-5086-5183-6753-7743.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
2034-5086-5183-6753-7743.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Heroic Feast triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 1.

1385-4496-5220-6900.description:
Cast Accursed Centaur by paying its mana cost.
Activate Accursed Centaur by sacrificing it.
When Accursed Centaur dies, Mortuary and Zulaport Cutthroat trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Accursed Centaur from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Cast Accursed Centaur from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3967-5570-6972.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Nardole
When Nardole dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Yahenni abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
3967-5570-6972.notes: If Nardole starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and without a -1/-1 counter on it

2313-3099-4762-6774.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Conclave Mentor and Loading Zone.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1170-1812-2440-7499.description:
Cast the copy of Pest Friend from exile by paying {B/G}.
When you cast that spell, Displacer Kitten triggers, flickering Lluwen, Exchange Student, which enters prepared.
When Lluwen, Exchange Student enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Resolve the spell from step 1, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
When the token enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} each time for each Pest you control.
Activate Prismite by paying {2}, adding one colored mana.
Repeat.

uses.n: Tui and La, Moon and Ocean

2464-3525-7065.description:
Activate Tui and La by tapping it, adding {U}.
Tui and La's first ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Tui and La.
Tui and La's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

3259-7060-7208.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7060-7208.description:
Declare Pestered Wellguard and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers. Pestered Wellguard triggers, creating a 1/1 Faerie creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Faerie token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

4153-6575-6965--136.description:
Activate Terra, Magical Adept by paying {4}{R}{G} and tapping it, exiling it and returning it to the battlefield as Esper Terra.
When Esper Terra enters the battlefield, its first chapter ability triggers, copying another nonlegendary Saga you control and putting two to three lore counters on it.
The Saga tokens first through fourth chapter abilities trigger, as applicable. Resolve all triggers, and sacrifice the Saga token upon resolving the final trigger.
When the Saga token leaves the battlefield, Resourceful Defense triggers, moving the lore counters from the Saga token onto Esper Terra.
Esper Terra's second, third and fourth chapter abilities trigger.
Resolve the second and third chapter abilities.
Resolve the fourth chapter ability, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G} and then exiling Esper Terra and returning it to the battlefield as Terra, Magical Adept.
Resourceful Defense and Terra, Magical Adept trigger.
Resolve the Resourceful Defense trigger, moving all counters from Esper Terra onto any other permanent
Resolve the Terra, Magical Adept trigger, causing you to mill five cards and return up to one enchantment card from among them from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
4153-6575-6965--136.notes: The chosen Saga must have no more than four chapter abilities. Once you have infinite white mana, you can instead copy any other permanent besides the chosen Saga, and move counters to and from Esper Terra using Resourceful Defense's ability.

1402-1849-2644-4763.description:
Cast Diamond Lion by paying {2}.
When Diamond Lion enters, Sai of the Shinobi triggers, attaching itself to Diamond Lion.
Activate Diamond Lion by tapping it, sacrificing it and discarding your hand, adding three mana of any color.
When Diamond Lion dies, Koll triggers, returning Diamond Lion from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1778-2173-4050-5220.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Memnite
When Memnite dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Memnite from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Memnite from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking The One Ring.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top from the battlefield onto the top of your library.
Activate The One Ring by tapping it, putting a burden counter on it and causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library.
Repeat.

5968-5972-6798.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
5968-5972-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Ghostly Dancers triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

Activate Mana Crypt by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Cast the other artifact with MV<=2 by paying at most {2}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Aether Channeler trigger, returning Mana Crypt from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Aether Channeler, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Cast Mana Crypt by paying {0}.
Teshar triggers, returning Aether Channeler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Aether Channeler enters the battlefield, it and Blasting Station trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Aether Channeler trigger, returning the other artifact from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Thornbite Staff attached to Embrose.
Embrose does not have summoning sickness.
You control another creature with toughness equal to 1.
2178-3490-4871-5622.description:
Activate Embrose by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on another creature you control with toughness equal to 1, and then dealing 2 damage to that creature.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Pitiless Plunderer and Animation Module trigger once, and Embrose triggers twice.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Holding priority, activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the first Embrose trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the second Embrose trigger, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

2459-3184-4050.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Rograkh, adding one mana of any color.
Rograkh dies, triggering Yomiji, returning Rograkh from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Repeat.

1309-1964-1987-2510.notablePrerequisites: Any instant exiled by Semblance Anvil.
1309-1964-1987-2510.description:
Activate Meteorite by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, targeting Meteorite and Salvager of Secrets, blinking them.
When Salvager of Secrets enters the battlefield, return Ghostly Flicker to you hand.
When Meteorite enters the battlefield, deal 2 damage to any target.
Repeat.

562-651-2603.description:
Activate Warrior en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Task Force.
Task Force triggers, giving itself +0/+3 until end of turn.
Resolve Warrior en-Kor's ability, causing the next one damage dealt to Warrior en-Kor this turn to be dealt to Task Force instead.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Cast Worthy Cause by paying {W} and sacrificing Task Force, causing you to gain life equal to Task Force's toughness.
